scope: Actual SCC preprocessing, at most2n star edges, DAG condensation on original edges, actual DAGGreedy output lifted with3β+2 hops and2n+F(q,β) size. No small-budget kernel or full general-directed asymptotic claim.

source_reference.matched_part: Section3.3 first bullet: two-way SCC representative stars and condensation/lifting

findings.detail: Constructs real allowed concatenated walks. Length grows by at most L per projected edge; diagonal endpoint cases use zero-length walks.

Setoid is actual mutual reachability; chosen representatives lie in their classes and are injective. Condensation edges witness actual original edges, not arbitrary transitive-closure edges. Reachability projects and lifts, and quotient reachability is antisymmetric.

Both directions of each representative star are legal closure edges; self edges are filtered and cardinality is at most2n. A condensed edge lifts as representative-to-tail, original edge, head-to-representative, at most3 hops. Shortcut edges lift directly. Endpoint stars add at most2 hops, yielding3β+2.

Uses the actual GraphGreedy output on the constructed quotient, with acyclicity discharged. Reachability equivalence and2n+F(q,β) cardinality follow. q≤1 is separately handled. For B≥5, floor((B−2)/3) is positive and3floor((B−2)/3)+2≤B.

scope_notes: The relation graph G may include diagonal edges from within-SCC edges. The imported DWalk model excludes self-loop steps and explicitly treats self loops as irrelevant; acyclicity and all downstream bounds are sound in that model. Do not call the raw relation irreflexive without filtering it.
These are finite noncomputable mathematical constructions using quotient representatives and the defined greedy output. An executable SCC implementation or runtime complexity is not proved here.
The second source bullet, small-budget sampled-kernel reduction, remains open. This review does not establish the complete general-directed theorem in that regime.

The final target-hop wrapper does not itself restate the cardinality bound after substituting floor((B−2)/3); that follows only by combining the displayed bounds and any desired asymptotic arithmetic.
The imported DAG theorem is an inspected interface, not independently re-proved in this bounded review.
completion_claim: Partial SCC preprocessing component only; no full-paper completion or final skeptical-audit claim.
